messages:
tay: heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a weird embed/rerank combo. after an auth refresh/replay we sometimes get null slots in the embedding array (then rerank zips wrong scores). repro below.

omar: ugh. which sdk + helper?

tay: js sdk v1.6.2 + batching helper v0.9. server infer v2026.03. token expiry + pad_to_max=true triggers it. minimal payload: 
```json
{
  "model": "open-embedding-small",
  "inputs": ["doc1", "doc2", "doc3"],
  "batcher": { "max_batch_size": 8, "pad_to_max": true },
  "pipeline": ["embed", "rerank"]
}
```

pat: two distinct issues we keep seeing: 1) field-name parity — some helpers return `vectors`, others `embeddings`. 2) pad type — older JS pad code inserts string "0" instead of numeric 0.0. float parsers choke.

zoe: ops logs show this sequence: `401 -> REFRESH -> immediate replay -> 429 -> server collapses batch -> response contains null placeholder(s) -> client zips indexes -> wrong scores assigned`. helper replay currently doesn't add backoff/jitter so duplicates are too close.

tay: example raw response we observed: 
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "request_id": "r_xyz123",
  "vectors": [null, [0.12,0.03, ...], [0.05,0.08,...]],
  "candidates": [ {"id":"doc1"}, {"id":"doc2"}, {"id":"doc3"} ]
}
```

omar: mixed shape + nulls = sampleapp panic territory. if one embed is null but scores array is dense we assign scores to wrong candidates.

pat: short-term workaround: disable helper auto-replay and set `batcher.pad_to_max=false` in onboarding guide. slower but prevents the string-pad + replay.

zoe: recommended fixes: 
- JS SDK: normalize output to `embeddings` (accept `vectors` server-side for backward compat)
- Ensure pad uses numeric 0.0 not "0"
- Add jittered exponential backoff to auth refresh replay path in helpers
- When pipeline=true, pad embeddings AND any parallel score arrays consistently; add length-checks before zipping

tay: i added a tiny repro fixture to repos/sampleapp/examples/embed-repro and filed DEVEX-3034 with logs.

omar: i'll take the auth-replay/backoff change. pat, can you own the pad normalization + envelope name mapping in the JS SDK?

pat: yep. i'll open a patch for v1.6.3 with mapping + pad type fix and add an integration test that accepts both `vectors` and `embeddings` shapes. will also add a linter to prevent string pads.

zoe: created OPS-4201 to temporarily disable auto-replay for pipeline requests. ci-bot: scheduled canary for js sdk v1.6.3 (patch) tomorrow 09:00 PT.

tay: confirmed local workaround works. will update the onboarding docs with the temp steps and link DEVEX-3034. thanks y'all! :thumbsup:
